lines.text: Why does your phone keep changing its Bluetooth address?
A fixed address would let scanners follow you around.
So Android swaps in a new random address at least every fifteen minutes.
To a stranger's scanner, it is a new device each time.
But paired devices share a secret key, so they still know it is you.
Your device name can still give you away, so keep it plain.
Download Meshline for private nearby messages, even offline.
